description: DSF2 C-terminal domain: secondary structure, pLDDT profile, and repeat period from structural self-superposition
code:
exec(open("work/lib.py").read())
import numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

fetch("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-P38213-F1-model_v6.pdb","work/AF-P38213.pdb")
res,order = parse_pdb("work/AF-P38213.pdb")
nums=np.array([r[1] for r in order]); seq="".join(res[r]['aa'] for r in order)
plddt=np.array([res[r]['b'] for r in order]); CA=np.array([res[r]['atoms']['CA'] for r in order])
SS = dssp_like(res,order)
hel = [h for h in ss_segments(SS,nums,minlen=5) if h[0]>=540]
print("DSF2 C-terminal helices (DSSP-like H-bond assignment):")
for k,h in enumerate(hel,1):
    print(f"  h{k:<2} {h[0]:>3}-{h[1]:<3} len={h[2]:<3} pLDDT={plddt[h[3]:h[4]+1].mean():5.1f}  {seq[h[3]:h[4]+1]}")
print("\nSS string 540-736:"); print(SS[539:])

# ---- repeat periodicity ----
lo,hi=548,731
idx=np.where((nums>=lo)&(nums<=hi))[0]; sub=CA[idx]
W=28; rows=[]
for p in range(18,75):
    r=[rmsd_after(sub[i:i+W],sub[i+p:i+p+W]) for i in range(0,len(sub)-W-p)]
    if r: rows.append((p,float(np.median(r)),float(np.min(r)),int(np.argmin(r))))
rows=np.array(rows)
print("\nRepeat periodicity scan (28-res CA windows, offset p):")
for p,m,mn,ai in rows[np.argsort(rows[:,2])][:10]:
    print(f"   p={int(p):>3}  minRMSD={mn:4.2f} A at start res {lo+int(ai)}   medianRMSD={m:4.2f}")

fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(11,6.5))
ax=axes[0]
ax.plot(nums,plddt,lw=1.0,color="#1f4e79")
ax.axhspan(0,50,color="#d9d9d9",alpha=.6); ax.axhspan(50,70,color="#f0e2c0",alpha=.6)
ax.axvspan(548,731,color="#8ecae6",alpha=.35)
for h in hel: ax.axvspan(h[0],h[1],ymin=0.92,ymax=1.0,color="#d62828")
ax.set_xlabel("DSF2 residue"); ax.set_ylabel("pLDDT"); ax.set_xlim(1,736)
ax.set_title("AlphaFold AF-P38213-F1-v6: one ordered C-terminal helical domain (548-731, mean pLDDT 89.9)")
ax=axes[1]
ax.plot(rows[:,0],rows[:,2],marker="o",ms=3,color="#d62828",label="minimum RMSD")
ax.plot(rows[:,0],rows[:,1],marker=".",ms=3,color="#6c757d",label="median RMSD")
ax.set_xlabel("sequence offset p (residues)"); ax.set_ylabel("CA RMSD of 28-res windows (A)")
ax.set_title("Structural self-similarity of the DSF2 548-731 domain: repeat period")
ax.legend(); ax.grid(alpha=.3)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
np.save("work/dsf2_rows.npy", rows)
